title: gdTProfiler
description: gdTProfiler profiles human γδ T cells in single-cell RNA-sequencing data using fixed, pre-trained models; TCR sequencing is not required. It jointly predicts cell identity (αβ T, γδ T or NK cell) with a softmax classifier, scores Vδ1/Vδ2 subtype conditionally within γδ T-cell calls, and projects cells onto eight transcriptional programmes from a fixed consensus NMF reference (K = 8), reporting programme usage together with a reconstruction-quality indicator. This release contains the Python package, the fixed model and reference files, a built-in example dataset, documentation and a tutorial. Programme usage describes transcriptional states; it is not a validated prediction of cytotoxic function or of response to perturbation.
